intro: Ten stories from the last day, rewritten in plain British English. Tap any word you don't know.

items.title: Zelenskyy asks for help with power grid
items.text: Ukraine's president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, spoke at the Ibero-American Summit in Madrid on Thursday. It was the first time Ukraine had taken part in the summit, which has 22 member nations. He asked Latin American leaders to help Ukraine get equipment for its power grid, which Russian attacks have damaged. Zelenskyy said every power plant in the country had been hit "in one way or another". He listed transformers, power cables and generators as the equipment Ukraine needs, and said it was needed fast.

gloss.power grid: the network that carries electricity to homes and businesses
gloss.transformer: a machine that changes the strength of an electric current
gloss.take part in: to join an event or activity
gloss.member nation: a country that belongs to a group

items.title: Fourth national strike hits France
items.text: Workers and students marched across France on Thursday in the fourth national strike over living costs and education funding. Euronews reported mass protests and school blockades. In Lyon, up to 55,000 people joined a march, and there were clashes and tear gas. Students also marched in Athens, where they demanded more money for education. The protests show how worried many people are about rising prices and the state of their schools.

gloss.strike: a time when workers refuse to work to protest
gloss.blockade: the act of closing a place so that nobody can enter or leave
gloss.tear gas: a gas that makes the eyes hurt, used by police to control crowds
gloss.cost of living: the amount of money people need for housing, food and other basics
gloss.march: to walk together in a group as a protest

items.title: Russell Brand found guilty at Southwark
items.text: Comedian Russell Brand has been found guilty of rape and three sexual assaults. The verdict was given at Southwark Crown Court in London on 5 November 2026, and the judge was Mr Justice Bennathan. The jury had begun considering its verdict earlier in the week. A court artist's sketch showed Brand in the dock as the result was announced.

gloss.found guilty: decided by a court to have committed a crime
gloss.verdict: the official decision of a jury or court
gloss.jury: a group of ordinary people who decide if someone is guilty
gloss.dock: the place in a court where the accused person stands or sits
gloss.court artist: a person who draws pictures in court where cameras are not allowed

items.title: Liverpool lose, Arsenal and City win in Europe
items.text: Liverpool lost for the first time in this season's Champions League. They were beaten 3-2 by Fenerbahce in Istanbul after twice giving up the lead. Arsenal won 2-1 at Slavia Prague, and Viktor Gyokeres doubled their lead. Manchester City also won 3-2, at RB Leipzig, with Erling Haaland scoring the late winner. He said City must step up. On Tuesday, Manchester United had beaten Roma 3-2 after trailing by two goals, and Matheus Cunha scored the equaliser and the winner.

gloss.give up the lead: to let the other team equalise or go ahead
gloss.double the lead: to make the lead twice as big
gloss.late winner: the goal that wins the match near the end
gloss.equaliser: a goal that makes the score level

items.title: Fritz beats Fils in Paris
items.text: Taylor Fritz beat Arthur Fils 6-3, 6-4 in the third round of the Paris Masters on Thursday. The match lasted one hour and 11 minutes. Fritz did not face a single break point and hit 14 aces. He now plays Carlos Alcaraz in the quarter-final on Friday, after Alcaraz received a walkover when Matteo Berrettini withdrew injured. Alcaraz leads their head-to-head 6-1. Fritz is 11th in the race for a place at the ATP Finals in Turin.

gloss.break point: a chance to win a game when the other player is serving
gloss.ace: a serve that the opponent cannot touch
gloss.walkover: a win given because the opponent cannot play
gloss.withdraw: to leave a competition before playing
gloss.head-to-head: the record of results between two players
gloss.quarter-final: a match with eight players left in the competition

items.title: New filter could make oil refining cheaper
items.text: Researchers have built a membrane that can separate crude oil at room temperature. It uses the oil itself to form tiny filtration channels. Separating crude oil into useful parts currently takes a great deal of energy. The researchers say the new method could cut the energy used in refining by nearly 32%. The study was reported by ScienceDaily on 5 November.

gloss.membrane: a thin layer that lets some things pass through and stops others
gloss.crude oil: oil in its natural form, before it is cleaned and processed
gloss.refining: the process of making a substance pure
gloss.filtration: the process of removing solid parts from a liquid
gloss.room temperature: the normal temperature inside a building

items.title: Ancient teeth reveal twist in human evolution
items.text: Scientists have extracted proteins from 400,000-year-old teeth. The results suggest that an ancient human species, once thought to be an evolutionary dead end, may have left genetic traces in people alive today. Proteins can survive for much longer than DNA, so they give researchers another way to study very old remains. The findings were reported on 5 November.

gloss.evolution: the slow change of living things over many generations
gloss.protein: a substance in living things that does many jobs in the body
gloss.genetic: connected with genes, the parts of cells passed from parents to children
gloss.trace: a small sign that something existed

items.title: Bank of England raises rates to 4%
items.text: The Bank of England raised its main interest rate to 4% on Thursday. The rate had been 3.75% since its September meeting. The decision was in line with what experts had forecast. Bank Rate affects the cost of mortgages and the interest paid on savings. The next decision is due on 17 December.

gloss.interest rate: the cost of borrowing money, shown as a percentage
gloss.mortgage: a loan used to buy a house
gloss.forecast: to say what will probably happen
gloss.in line with: the same as what was expected
gloss.savings: money that is kept and not spent

items.title: GTA VI preload starts next week
items.text: Rockstar Games has said GTA VI launches on 19 November on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. Digital copies can be preloaded from 10 November, and the PS5 download starts at midnight local time. The preload file needs 212GB of space on the console. Rockstar is not making discs, so code-in-box versions should reach shops from 12 November. On launch day, fans can also download a free poster and a map of Leonida from the Rockstar website.

gloss.preload: to download a game before its official release
gloss.launch: the day a product first goes on sale
gloss.code-in-box: a boxed game that contains a download code instead of a disc
gloss.retailer: a shop that sells goods to the public
gloss.storage: space on a device where files are kept

items.title: PlayStation gives four steps before GTA VI
items.text: PlayStation has told players to take four steps before GTA VI launches on 19 November. They should set up a PlayStation account, pre-order the game, get ready to pre-download it and finish setting up their PS5. PlayStation said it will share more information as launch day gets closer. No PS5 exclusive content has been confirmed yet, but the console offers features such as 3D audio, fast loading and DualSense haptics. Full details for the PS5 Pro are still to come.

gloss.pre-order: to pay for a product before it is released
gloss.exclusive: available only in one place or on one product
gloss.haptics: feedback that you feel through touch, such as vibration
gloss.as launch day gets closer: as the release date comes nearer
gloss.set up: to prepare something so that it is ready to use
